name: lean
description: Experimental, coarse: ten tools, one-line descriptions, no server instructions. Asks whether the onboarding text and the orient/evaluate tools earn their tokens.

tools.description: How well the grammar analyzes the project's texts.
List grammar objects by kind, with ids.
What FieldWorks holds for one word.
Add a lexeme form (and optional gloss) to an existing entry in a draft.
Set a sense's gloss in a draft.
Parse sample words with and without the draft's changes.
Finalize the Draft so the linguist can review it.
